scheduleEditor.title: Schedule
scheduleEditor.intervalHint: These times use the preview time as an example baseline. Actual intervals start at Beat startup or the last dispatch, without waiting for task completion. Restarting Beat resets the baseline.

crontabEditor.clockAligned: Aligned to the start of each hour. Use an Interval schedule for a fixed elapsed interval.
crontabEditor.advancedHint: Order: minute, hour, day, month, weekday. Supports *, ranges, steps, lists and Celery names. Weekdays are 0–6; Sunday is 0. Date and weekday must both match.
crontabEditor.monthHint: Missing dates are skipped, e.g. April has no day 31.
